digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: Verified-lane dispatch volume on main, not tickets-branch pushes, saturated the Actions pool during 2026-08-12/13 incidents; the tickets branch has no workflows and produced zero Actions runs.

Current per-run slot cost ranges from 17 runner jobs for full routes without mutation to 24 with all seven mutation shards; immediate peak fan-out after classification is 13 jobs, with theoretical maximum simultaneous demand of 19.

Observed incident-period burst on 2026-08-13 reached 22 waiting jobs and 16 running jobs with 873s maximum runner wait; current-period three-run bursts reach 22 waiting jobs but only 15 running, consistent with shared-org queue contention.
The organization plan is Free with 20 total concurrent job slots and 5 macOS slots; repository-local queue depth is a lower bound due to shared navapbc org demand from other repositories.
Option A (bundle preflights and cap mutation at 3 parallel) reduces maximum slots from 24 to 21 and immediate fan-out from 13 to 10 while preserving all coverage; recommended as first intervention.
Option C (move macOS from pre-merge Verified to scheduled main health) eliminates macOS queue pressure pre-merge but delays platform-specific regression detection by up to six hours.
